_comment: Editorial content for DWTM. The company has not operated its plant since 2015, so no product list is given: a list of yarns it no longer produces would misrepresent it. No image is attached. Add imagePath/imageSource/imageLicence together when a real one is available.
description: Dewan Textile Mills Limited was incorporated in Pakistan on 16 April 1970 as a public limited company. Its principal business is the manufacture and sale of yarn, and its factory is at H/20 and H/26, S.I.T.E. Kotri, District Dadu, Sindh. The company has suspended its manufacturing operations since December 2015.
headOffice: Dewan Centre, 3-A, Lalazar Beach Luxury Hotel Road, Karachi 75350, Pakistan
